# Portfolio Development Setup

This is the workspace for the premium fullstack developer portfolio of Trần Gia Bảo.

## Project Overview

- **Framework**: Next.js 14 with TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS with dark mode
- **Animations**: Framer Motion
- **State Management**: React Query
- **Icons**: React Icons

## Technology Stack

- NestJS (Backend)
- Next.js (Frontend)
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Framer Motion
- React Query
- React Icons

## Folder Structure

```
src/
├── app/               # Next.js app directory
├── components/        # Reusable components (Button, Card, etc.)
├── sections/          # Page sections (Hero, About, Projects, etc.)
├── animations/        # Framer Motion animation variants
├── hooks/             # Custom React hooks
├── lib/               # Utility functions
├── data/              # Static data (projects, experience, tech stack)
├── types/             # TypeScript type definitions
```

## Getting Started

1. Install dependencies: `npm install`
2. Run dev server: `npm run dev`
3. Build for production: `npm run build`
4. Start production server: `npm start`

## Development

- Dev server runs on `http://localhost:3000`
- Components use TypeScript for type safety
- All animations are handled with Framer Motion
- Responsive design with mobile-first approach
- Dark mode by default with Tailwind CSS

## Key Features

- ✨ Cinematic smooth scrolling
- 🎨 Modern glassmorphism design
- ⚡ Smooth Framer Motion animations
- 📱 Fully responsive mobile design
- 🎯 Recruiter-ready portfolio sections
- 🚀 Optimized Next.js performance
